description: This file defines the UserController class within the Conduit.Features.Users namespace. It provides HTTP endpoints for retrieving and updating user details, utilizing ASP.NET Core MVC, MediatR for command/query handling, and JWT-based authorization.

classes.name: UserController
classes.description: Controller handling user-related HTTP requests, specifically for fetching current user details and updating user information.

methods.name: GetCurrent
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve the current user's details using their username.

methods.name: UpdateUser
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update user information based on provided command data.
